Seeing as you are a neighbor of a close ally of mine, Hydronia, I would like to propose a few things. Due to your strategic location near shipping lanes as well as gold reserves, we are willing to provide a few things.

[b][u]Tartakum-ULR Friendship and Mining Deal Draft[/u][/b]

[b]Diplomacy & Trade[/b]
1.a: Both nations will establish embassies with each other, allowing for diplomatic staff to live in the radius of such embassies with special visas.
1.b: Buildings or plots of land for these embassies will be provided by each state.
1.c: Tartakum will be allowed into the EEHP as an observer, granting a path to future membership.
1.d: The ULR will put in a good word for Tartakum in application for the THEP partnership program.
1.e: Tartakum will allow Lavian ships to dock, resupply, and even hire crew in their ports.
1.f: Lavia will be allowed to purchase from the Tartakan market, providing a flow of money from exports.

[b]Mining[/b]
2.a: The Tartakan government will partner with Lavian mining firms to extract gold from their northeastern land.
2.b: Lavian mining firms will train Tartakan workers in operation of machinery, vehicles, and processing equipment.
2.c: Lavian mining firms will provide most equipment used and hire local workers, helping improve the local economy.
2.d: A profit split of 70:30 between the Lavian firms and the Tartakan government, improving the Tartakan budget.

[b]Military[/b]
3.a: Lavian military experts will help train Tartakan recruits and improve tactics.
3.b: The Tartakan military will be supplied with 150 MAVH-15 LPAPCs and 50 MAVH-15 LCFVs to improve their armored capabilities.
3.c: The Tartakan airforce will be allowed to purchase 10 units of the Manzatron Soldier Ant for a price of $8m, with the Lavian govenment paying the rest of the cost for the aircraft.
3.d: Lavian military exports such as the purchasing of equipment, ammunition, spare arts, and training of use and maintenance on such equipment will remain open to Tartakum for the foreseeable future, only being closed off if one nation violates the terms of this agreement.
3.e: The Tartakan and Lavian militaries will be able to participate in joint exercises, improving readiness of both nations.[/quote]

Send me a telegram on this and I will think on this. I don't really feel good about the 70:30 split
